issue.title: Rename sase modules from xprompt to macro
issue.description: Outside the TUI, query-language status macros are shorthands, the xprompt package and sibling modules live on macro paths, identifiers follow a token-aware rename, external plugins still import the old paths through one temporary shim, and a terminology guard holds that boundary.
